item.question: What are the key differences between MMAudio and Movie Gen Audio in terms of data usage and performance?
item.answer: MMAudio uses publicly available data, while Movie Gen Audio is trained on extensive non-public data. In performance, MMAudio is comparable to Movie Gen Audio in subjective assessments but slightly worse in semantic alignment and better in temporal alignment.
